objects.name: principledVolume
objects.description: directly parameterized participating medium whose optical properties are driven by spatial fields or constant values

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: optional object name

parameters.name: bounds
parameters.description: object-space medium domain; must have finite coordinates and strictly positive extents

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: optional auxiliary output ID

parameters.name: visible
parameters.description: whether this volume is visible

parameters.name: density
parameters.description: scale on total extinction: sigma_t = density * -log(transmissionColor) / transmissionDistance; 0 disables extinction and thermal emission; when a field is bound, the effective value is this constant multiplied by the field sample, or by 'density.outside' outside the field's domain

parameters.name: density.outside
parameters.description: multiplier applied to 'density' outside the density field's domain

parameters.name: density.field
parameters.description: scalar field multiplied by 'density'

parameters.name: scatteringColor
parameters.description: linear-RGB single-scattering albedo in [0, 1]: sigma_s = sigma_t * scatteringColor, sigma_a = sigma_t * (1 - scatteringColor); when a field is bound, the effective value is this constant multiplied by the field sample, or by 'scatteringColor.outside' outside the field's domain

parameters.name: scatteringColor.outside
parameters.description: multiplier applied to 'scatteringColor' outside the scatteringColor field's domain

parameters.name: scatteringColor.field
parameters.description: linear-RGB field multiplied by 'scatteringColor'

parameters.name: transmissionColor
parameters.description: linear-RGB transmittance in (0, 1] over transmissionDistance at density 1; sets total extinction sigma_t, which scatteringColor splits into scattering and absorption; a channel of exactly 1 has zero extinction; when a field is bound, the effective value is this constant multiplied by the field sample, or by 'transmissionColor.outside' outside the field's domain

parameters.name: transmissionColor.outside
parameters.description: multiplier applied to 'transmissionColor' outside the transmissionColor field's domain

parameters.name: transmissionColor.field
parameters.description: linear-RGB field multiplied by 'transmissionColor'

parameters.name: transmissionDistance
parameters.description: world-space distance over which transmissionColor is reached at density 1; must be positive wherever extinction is nonzero; when a field is bound, the effective value is this constant multiplied by the field sample, or by 'transmissionDistance.outside' outside the field's domain

parameters.name: transmissionDistance.outside
parameters.description: multiplier applied to 'transmissionDistance' outside the transmissionDistance field's domain

parameters.name: transmissionDistance.field
parameters.description: scalar field multiplied by 'transmissionDistance'

parameters.name: anisotropy
parameters.description: Henyey-Greenstein anisotropy of the primary phase lobe, in [-1, 1]; when a field is bound, the effective value is this constant multiplied by the field sample, or by 'anisotropy.outside' outside the field's domain

parameters.name: anisotropy.outside
parameters.description: multiplier applied to 'anisotropy' outside the anisotropy field's domain

parameters.name: anisotropy.field
parameters.description: scalar field multiplied by 'anisotropy'

parameters.name: secondaryAnisotropy
parameters.description: Henyey-Greenstein anisotropy of the secondary phase lobe, in [-1, 1]; when a field is bound, the effective value is this constant multiplied by the field sample, or by 'secondaryAnisotropy.outside' outside the field's domain

parameters.name: secondaryAnisotropy.outside
parameters.description: multiplier applied to 'secondaryAnisotropy' outside the secondaryAnisotropy field's domain

parameters.name: secondaryAnisotropy.field
parameters.description: scalar field multiplied by 'secondaryAnisotropy'

parameters.name: secondaryWeight
parameters.description: blend weight of the secondary phase lobe, in [0, 1]; when a field is bound, the effective value is this constant multiplied by the field sample, or by 'secondaryWeight.outside' outside the field's domain

parameters.name: secondaryWeight.outside
parameters.description: multiplier applied to 'secondaryWeight' outside the secondaryWeight field's domain

parameters.name: secondaryWeight.field
parameters.description: scalar field multiplied by 'secondaryWeight'

parameters.name: emission
parameters.description: linear-RGB emitted radiance per unit world-space length; not scaled by density; when a field is bound, the effective value is this constant multiplied by the field sample, or by 'emission.outside' outside the field's domain

parameters.name: emission.outside
parameters.description: multiplier applied to 'emission' outside the emission field's domain

parameters.name: emission.field
parameters.description: linear-RGB field multiplied by 'emission'

parameters.name: temperature
parameters.description: blackbody temperature in kelvin; thermal emission is sigma_a * blackbodyTint * blackbodyIntensity * B(temperature), where B is absolute Planck radiance (W m^-2 sr^-1, not luminance-normalized) integrated over 360-830 nm against the CIE 1931 2-degree observer, scaled by the fixed constant that gives a D65-shaped spectrum of unit 360-830 nm radiance Y = 1, converted to linear Rec.709/sRGB primaries without chromatic adaptation, and with out-of-gamut colors clamped to nonnegative RGB while preserving Y; B is 0 for temperature <= 0; the default of 1 lets a bound field supply kelvin directly; when a field is bound, the effective value is this constant multiplied by the field sample, or by 'temperature.outside' outside the field's domain

parameters.name: temperature.outside
parameters.description: multiplier applied to 'temperature' outside the temperature field's domain

parameters.name: temperature.field
parameters.description: scalar field multiplied by 'temperature'

parameters.name: blackbodyIntensity
parameters.description: scale applied to blackbody emission; 0 disables thermal emission; when a field is bound, the effective value is this constant multiplied by the field sample, or by 'blackbodyIntensity.outside' outside the field's domain

parameters.name: blackbodyIntensity.outside
parameters.description: multiplier applied to 'blackbodyIntensity' outside the blackbodyIntensity field's domain

parameters.name: blackbodyIntensity.field
parameters.description: scalar field multiplied by 'blackbodyIntensity'

parameters.name: blackbodyTint
parameters.description: linear-RGB tint applied to blackbody emission; when a field is bound, the effective value is this constant multiplied by the field sample, or by 'blackbodyTint.outside' outside the field's domain

parameters.name: blackbodyTint.outside
parameters.description: multiplier applied to 'blackbodyTint' outside the blackbodyTint field's domain

parameters.name: blackbodyTint.field
parameters.description: linear-RGB field multiplied by 'blackbodyTint'
